He then argued that Tang Ruowang had wrongly made Shunzhi 18's intercalary tenth month into an intercalary seventh; in the Refutation of Errors and anti-heterodoxy essays he had composed, he attacked Tang Ruowang fiercely and denounced Catholicism as delusion misleading the people.

上所為摘謬、辟邪諸論 names Yang Guangxian's prior Refutation of Errors and anti-heterodoxy essays, not imperial compositions; the original wrongly attributes them to the emperor, and the proposed agent matches 既又論…攻…斥.

He then again argued that Tang Ruowang had mistakenly taken the intercalary tenth month of Shunzhi 18 as the intercalary seventh month; the emperor composed the Refutation of Errors and various treatises repelling heterodoxy, attacking Tang Ruowang with great force and denouncing the Catholicism he professed as wild talk deluding the masses.

He then again argued that Tang Ruowang had mistakenly taken the intercalary tenth month of Shunzhi 18 as the intercalary seventh month; the Refutation of Errors and various treatises repelling heterodoxy that he had previously composed attacked Tang Ruowang with great force and denounced the Catholicism he professed as wild talk deluding the masses.
The literal likewise misreads 上所為 as imperial authorship; Yang is the composer of 摘謬、辟邪諸論 and the agent of 攻…斥, so the proposed referent correction is required.
Mingxuan was Wu Mingxuan's younger brother; Wu Mingxuan's petition to restore the Muslim section had failed—now Mingxuan served as Yang Guangxian's deputy for calculations.

Wu Míngxuǎn and Wu Míngxuàn were kinsmen of the same generation. Wu Míngxuàn's petition to restore the Muslim section had been denied; now Wu Míngxuǎn served as Yang Guangxian's deputy in charge of calculations.
明烜 and 明炫 are distinct; 兄弟行 indicates same-generation kinship, not a younger brother. Tone-marked pinyin distinguishes the two men without inserting Chinese characters into the English field.
